records.name: Biopython
records.citation: Cock et al. (2009), Biopython: freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology and bioinformatics.
records.license: Biopython License Agreement; selected files are also BSD-3-Clause
records.notes: Do not describe the entire distribution as BSD-3-Clause; retain the Biopython license notice.

records.name: SeqKit
records.citation: Shen, Sipos and Zhao (2024), SeqKit2: A Swiss army knife for sequence and alignment processing.
records.notes: DNAKit exposes bounded FASTA/FASTQ operations and does not claim to reimplement the complete SeqKit CLI.

records.name: scikit-bio
records.citation: Aton et al. (2026), Scikit-bio: a fundamental Python library for biological omic data analysis.
records.notes: The DNAKit adapter exposes bounded statistics, not the complete scikit-bio namespace.

records.name: DNA Chisel
records.citation: Zulkower and Rosser (2020), DNA Chisel, a versatile sequence optimizer.
records.notes: Optimization results must report the exact specification classes and package version.

records.name: seqme
records.notes: Report model names and model-weight licenses separately from the seqme code license.

records.name: pydna
records.citation: Pereira et al. (2015), Pydna: a simulation and documentation tool for DNA assembly strategies using python.
records.notes: Assembly output should record the pydna version and input construct definitions.

records.name: Biotite
records.citation: Kunzmann and Hamacher (2018), Biotite: a unifying open source computational biology framework in Python.
records.notes: The adapter records the substitution matrix, gap penalty and alignment mode.

records.name: Edlib
records.citation: Šošić and Šikić (2017), Edlib: a C/C++ library for fast, exact sequence alignment using edit distance.
records.notes: Report NW/HW/SHW mode, task, k and coordinate convention with each result.

records.name: pyfaidx
records.citation: Shirley et al. (2015), Efficient "pythonic" access to FASTA files using pyfaidx, PeerJ PrePrints 3:e1196.
records.notes: The cited item is a CC-BY-4.0 preprint; the pyfaidx source code remains separately licensed under BSD-3-Clause.

records.name: dnaio
records.citation: Martin and Vorderman, dnaio software archive, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10548864.
records.notes: This is a software archive DOI, not a peer-reviewed article DOI; cite Cutadapt separately when its methods are used.

records.name: mappy/minimap2
records.citation: Li (2018), Minimap2: pairwise alignment for nucleotide sequences.
records.notes: Report whether the Python binding or the standalone minimap2 executable was used.

records.name: sourmash
records.citation: sourmash project, Journal of Open Source Software, DOI 10.21105/joss.06830.
records.notes: Report k-mer size, scaled value, abundance mode and whether a database was used.

records.name: Cutadapt
records.citation: Martin (2011), Cutadapt removes adapter sequences from high-throughput sequencing reads.
records.notes: Report the exact adapter sequences and filtering parameters, not only the package name.

records.name: fastp
records.citation: Chen (2025), fastp 2: Scalable quality control and preprocessing for high-throughput sequencing data.
records.notes: Record the fastp version and JSON report together with all filtering thresholds.

records.name: FastQC
records.citation: FastQC project documentation and the exact released version used.
records.notes: The survey supplied no DOI; include project URL, version, access date and report settings.

records.name: MultiQC
records.citation: Ewels et al. (2016), MultiQC: summarize analysis results for multiple tools and samples in a single report.
records.notes: Report the input modules, configuration and output report version.

records.name: primer3-py
records.citation: Primer3 project documentation and the exact released version used.
records.notes: Citable in a paper, but distribution and linking obligations must be reviewed separately.

records.name: iLearnPlus
records.citation: Chen et al. (2021), iLearnPlus: a comprehensive and automatic machine-learning platform for DNA, RNA and protein sequence analysis.
records.notes: Do not copy or redistribute source until a repository-level license is confirmed.

records.name: NUPACK
records.citation: NUPACK documentation and the exact version or subscription used.
records.license: Restricted commercial/service terms; verify the active terms
records.notes: Citing the service is separate from redistributing code, building a hosted wrapper or distributing model-generated code.
